title: Germany August preliminary CPI +2.9% vs +3.0% y/y expected
description: Prior +2.8% HICP +2.9% vs +3.1% y/y expected Prior +2.8% Core CPI Y/Y +2.4% vs +2.4% prior Full report here Germany’s inflation rate is expected to rise to 2.9% y/y in August. On a monthly basis, consumer prices increased by 0.2% compared with July. The Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP), the measure used for comparisons across the Eurozone and which the ECB targets, also rose 2.9% annually and 0.2% monthly, matching the national CPI reading. title: Treas. Sec Bessent at the G20: Iran taking sanctions seriously
description: Bessent at the G20: Iran is taking sanctions seriously Iran is lashing out kinetically because they are losing economically We will continue to exert pressure Iran's economy doesn't have to collapse just needs to come to its senses Real wages are growing Only way to get out of debt is to grow our way out of debt.
